legs.description: Legs in this packet, oldest first.

RepoAnchor.description: The repo identity, HEAD, branch and snapshot a packet is true at.

repo_id.description: BLAKE3 of the newline-joined sorted root commit oids. Stable across clones.

head.description: HEAD commit, `None` on an unborn branch.

snapshot.description: Snapshot of the full working state.

SnapshotRef.description: A snapshot commit kept alive by a private ref.

base.description: Parent commit (HEAD at snapshot time), if any.

ref_name.description: Ref that keeps the commit alive, e.g. `refs/firsthand/snapshots/snp_...`.

linked.description: Whether this is a linked worktree.

name.description: Worktree name (directory name under `.git/worktrees`), if linked.

DirtySummary.description: Counts of uncommitted changes and files deliberately left out.

added.description: Files added to the index or new.

omitted.description: Files that would have been captured but were excluded.

Omitted.description: A file excluded from a snapshot, with the reason. Nothing is dropped silently.

hash.description: BLAKE3 of the content, if computed (never for secrets).

OmitReason.description: Reason a file was excluded from a snapshot.

oneOf.description: Submodule content (recorded as a gitlink only).

Leg.description: One contiguous stretch of work by one agent session.

agent_session.description: The agent's own session id, if known.

ledger.description: Ledger range covered by this leg.

version.description: Agent version, from `--version` or hook payloads.

model.description: Model name, if the harness reports it.

oneOf.description: Any other agent, through `firsthand run`, MCP, or the CLI.

PacketRef.description: Reference to a packet by id and manifest hash.

LineageNode.description: Ancestor summary in a packet's lineage.

status_counts.description: Claim status counts at seal time.

Claim.description: A statement about the repo or the work, with scope, probe and results.

ClaimOrigin.description: Who asserted a claim and how confident the source is.

confidence_permille.description: Confidence in permille (0 to 1000). Integer, never a float.

symbols.description: Symbols with body and signature hashes.

ScopedFile.description: A file in a claim scope.

blob.description: Blob at anchor time; `None` means absent at anchor.

ScopedSymbol.description: A symbol in a claim scope.

path.description: File containing the symbol at anchor time.

Probe.description: A checkable procedure attached to a claim. Everything except `Command` is static.

oneOf.description: File is absent from the tree.
File content matches a regex at least `min` times.
Number of files matching a glob compares to `n`.
A branch points at a commit.
A path has no uncommitted changes.
No symbol with this name exists.
A symbol body has exactly this hash.
Cross-check against the latest witnessed verification command. Executes nothing.

cwd_rel.description: Working directory relative to the repo root.

shell.description: Run through a shell (requires `allow_shell` and explicit approval).

CommandMatcher.description: Filters witnessed commands by argv prefix.

LedgerRequire.description: Requirement for a ledger verification probe.

oneOf.description: Parsed tests: zero failed and more than zero passed.

Expect.description: Expected outcome of a command probe.

oneOf.description: Could not run (spawn failure, parse error).
Needs approval before it can run.

BlobRef.description: Reference to a stored output blob.

hash.description: Hash of the stored (redacted, possibly truncated) bytes.

Task.description: A task in the task DAG.

evidence.description: Claims offered as evidence of completion.

TaskEvent.description: One change in a task's history.

Decision.description: A decision with its reasons and constraint strength.

active.description: Whether it is still in force.

ConstraintKind.description: Constraint strength. `must` and `must_not` are never dropped from briefs.

Attempt.description: Something that was tried and did not work.

why.description: Why it failed or was abandoned.

HearsayItem.description: A transcript-extracted or imported statement. Always untrusted.

claim.description: Claim extracted from this quote, if any.

ts.description: Timestamp in the source, if any.

DriftBaseline.description: Per-scope hashes at seal time, used to compute drift later.

files.description: Files referenced by any claim scope.

symbols.description: Symbols referenced by any claim scope.

RedactionReport.description: Redaction counts per rule. Never contains secret values.

excluded_files.description: Files excluded from the snapshot as secrets.

overlay.description: Whether a seal-time overlay map was needed.

SealInfo.description: Who sealed a packet and why.
